name: file_tree
description: List directory structure. Shows files and folders with sizes.

manual.overview: Use file_tree to get an overview of a project's directory structure. Shows folders and files hierarchically with sizes. Essential first step when exploring an unfamiliar project.
tips: Start with depth=1 or 2 for a high-level overview, then go deeper on interesting directories.
Use glob to filter for specific file types when the tree is too large.
Check file_tree before file_search to understand where code lives.
edge_cases: Very large directories (node_modules, .git) may produce huge output; limit depth.
Hidden files (starting with .) are included by default.
Symbolic links are followed but cycles are detected and stopped.
